steps.npc: You're better off speaking with the Siren, that is her area of expertise. All I know is that the beast poses a huge risk to Mother.
At least for the moment, Mother is not in any direct danger. I fear it is only a matter of time before the beast enters her mind again though.
These are the masks of the Sisterhood. While symbolic, they also have practical uses.
Herbs can be stored within the beak, masking the smell of death and preventing us from becoming infected.

steps.player: That sounds handy. Can I have one?

steps.npc: No. To wear a mask of the Sisterhood, you need to join the Sisterhood.
I'm afraid you lack the qualities we're currently looking for. Perhaps another time.

options.text: Do you have any of my items?

steps.player: Do you have any of my items?

steps.text: If the player has no items in Sister Senga's collection:
If the player has items in Sister Senga's collection:

steps.npc: I do, traveller. You should be more cautious with them.

standard-dialogue-when-trying-to-interac.npc: I would advise against doing that, traveller. You do not yet know what you are up against.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: What are you doing up here?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: Phosani, the founder of our sect and creator of this sanctuary. She is our mother, and always will be.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: I see... So where is she?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: Dead? No. She sleeps the everlasting slumber.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: Right. The coffin looks pretty secure to me. Why do you need to keep an eye on her.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: The creature down there, the one that Siren calls the Nightmare. It has been invading Mother's mind, feeding on her.
Mother is strong, but not strong enough to fight it off alone. She needs help.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: Needs help does she? Maybe I could be of assistance?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: The offer is appreciated. Luckily for us though, the Nightmare is not present in Mother's mind at the moment.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: Fair enough. If that changes, I'm more than willing to help.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.text: If the player does not have at least one normal Nightmare kill:

steps.npc: The offer is appreciated. I fear you do not have the abilities to take on that sort of challenge though.
The horror that has manifested itself in Mother's mind is far stronger than the one fought in the Nightmare's dream.
If you hope to have a chance, you'll want to take on the weaker form first. That Siren down there can help you.

steps.player: Fair enough. I'll be back once I have more experience.

steps.prompt: Would you like to attempt the fight anyway?

steps.npc: That would be appreciated, traveller. You can use the pool here to enter Mother's mind and take on the Nightmare within.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.text: If the player have at least one normal Nightmare kill:

steps.npc: That would be appreciated, traveller. You can use the pool here to enter Mother's mind and take on the Nightmare within.
Be warned though. If you enter, you enter alone. No one else can help you with this one.

steps.player: I see. I'll have to be careful then.
